expectations.requirement: Independent ratings are preserved and median aggregation is correct.
expectations.inputOrInjectedFault: Three fixed reviewer-rating sets, including a known median case.
expectations.expectedResult: Original ratings preserved; computed medians equal fixture expectations.

expectations.requirement: Disagreement and critical findings block approval.
expectations.inputOrInjectedFault: Conflicting ratings plus one reviewer-only critical defect.
expectations.expectedResult: Spread >=2 requires adjudication and unresolved critical defect blocks approval.

expectations.inputOrInjectedFault: Controlled fixtures for all seven failure classes plus mocked provider faults.
expectations.expectedResult: Each failure triggers its prescribed stop action and cannot resume without required evidence.

expectations.requirement: Repairs remain visible in first-pass and accumulated-cost metrics.
expectations.inputOrInjectedFault: Known jobs, costs, retries, failures and repairs.
expectations.expectedResult: Calculated denominators/cost totals equal fixture values and repaired failures remain first-pass failures.

expectations.requirement: Artifact changes invalidate exactly the dependent approvals.
expectations.inputOrInjectedFault: Controlled source, prose, image and export-configuration changes.
expectations.expectedResult: Affected approvals reopen; unaffected approvals remain reusable only when dependencies are unchanged.

expectations.requirement: Immutable release package is sufficient to reconstruct the decision.
expectations.inputOrInjectedFault: Candidate package with IDs, hashes, reviews, defects, regressions, exports, costs and approvals.
expectations.expectedResult: Validation accepts complete package and rejects a package missing any mandatory identity/evidence field.

expectations.requirement: Book, software and protocol promotion states remain independent.
expectations.inputOrInjectedFault: Three separate promotion-domain records with mixed outcomes.
expectations.expectedResult: No domain is promoted because another domain passed; each retains its own status/evidence.
